diagnosis.root_cause: The activator (opintel_intelligence_worker.sampled_slot_execution_main) requires a valid m67.phase1.sampled-slot-execution-approval@3 SampledSlotExecutionApprovalEnvelope on /m67-phase1/sampled-slot-execution-approval before it can apply the release and derive the Slot 01 work item. The repository contained the accepted owner authority (statement + acceptance record with the experiment/approval/release/lease/work-item ids and the exact ceilings) and the frozen registries, but no code path that assembles the @3 envelope. Several immutable release-binding fields (workspace_id, source_registry_id/hash, retention_policy_id/hash, environment_id/hash, cohort_policy_id, kill_switch_id, current_release_id) exist only in the current predecessor research-release object in SSM, and no deployed runtime identity can both read that object and write the approval parameter.
diagnosis.not_a_governance_change: No ceiling, scope, host, slot, robots/TLS/SSRF/minimization/provenance/truth control is altered. The @3 approval validator is unchanged and is used, unmodified, to validate the materialized envelope.

minimum_change.terraform_change: infra/terraform/phase1/observability.tf: add aws_iam_role_policy.authority_materialization (dedicated inline policy on the existing m67-phase1-operator role)

field_source_classification.cross_checks: Every registry SHA and the deployed runtime revision must also appear verbatim in the accepted owner statement; statement-parsed identifiers must equal the acceptance record; a wrong/absent value fails closed before any SSM write.

security_property.failure_is_pre_write: Any stale, altered, reused, expired or mismatched input raises AuthorityMaterializationError before the approval parameter is written; no release, work item, coordinator, egress lease or DNS occurs.
security_property.production_consumer_dry_run: materialize() instantiates the exact activator-side BoundedSampledSlotReleaseApplicator against an in-memory copy of (envelope, current research-release, kill switch) and requires it to return a fresh AUTHORIZED release whose id == authorized_release_id and whose configuration_hash == approval_artifact_sha256. The envelope is only returned/written if that production validator accepts it.
security_property.idempotency: If the approval parameter already holds a byte-equal envelope the materializer returns it and writes nothing; if it holds a different envelope it fails closed.
security_property.single_use_preserved: The activator still consumes the release and restores the kill switch; restore mode writes the exact NOT_AUTHORIZED sentinel back to the approval parameter after the bounded run.

authority_identity.chosen: existing m67-phase1-operator role (already the bounded human-assumed orchestration identity for this exact experiment; already assumable by the approved operator principal; already granted ecs:DescribeTaskDefinition by the Window 2 apply)
authority_identity.rejected_alternative: dedicated ecs-tasks-only m67-phase1-authority-materializer role + task definition + worker image rebuild + operator RunTask/PassRole grants
authority_identity.rejection_reason: Disproportionate to a one-shot deterministic build; would require an image publication and new infrastructure. Preferred the smallest proven correction (repository principle) under an existing bounded role.
authority_identity.least_privilege: New inline policy m67-phase1-authority-materialization grants ssm:GetParameter on exactly {research-release, kill-switch, sampled-slot-execution-approval} and ssm:PutParameter on exactly {sampled-slot-execution-approval}. No broad ssm:GetParameter/PutParameter. The activator's sampled_slot_executor role is unchanged and still cannot write the approval parameter.
